defensives.name: Fortifying Brew
defensives.usage_rule: Press it before a hit you know is coming at you, since it is your largest personal reduction.

defensives.name: Dampen Harm
defensives.usage_rule: Use it against big single hits, which it cuts hardest.

defensives.name: Diffuse Magic
defensives.usage_rule: Pop it for magic burst and to send the magic debuffs on you back to their caster.

defensives.name: Touch of Karma
defensives.usage_rule: Cover a predictable burst on yourself with it and push the absorbed damage back into your target.
